title: Nest a child recipe under a tool_call graph node
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Fangore’s generate-image tool should run a child oneshot recipe under that tool step so operators can zoom into prompt → generate → verify without a parallel soft lane. Nested spend shares the parent budget; failure surfaces on the tool node. Complements `fangore_insp_dynamic_subgraph`, `fangore_insp_budget_subgraph_rollup`, and `fangore_conversational_tool_loop`. He walks product steps (recipe_plan) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^june-hf08][^insp-sr-02-tool]
implementation: `mechaharness.node_component.embed_recipe_as_tool` attaches a child `ExecutionGraph` on a `tool_call` graph node using the same nest shape as `SubgraphNodeRunner.embed`. `GraphExecutor` runs the child with `child_run_id` and shared budget (HF-08). Parent exposes a `child_graph` node component via `node_components_for`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `recipe_as_tool.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
